plan.summary: Key week: structured VO2max intervals on Wednesday, progressive long run targeting 19 km on Sunday. Gym sessions for upper body and core. Easy runs to maintain volume without fatigue.

sessions.description: VO2max intervals — 4×4 min at max effort with 3 min walking recovery
Long run — 19 km at easy pace (6:30-7:00/km)

review.summary: Exceptional volume week with 44.3 km across 5 runs, headlined by an unplanned half-marathon (21.1 km, 6:01/km) on Sunday — Duarte's first HM-distance training run, 2.1 km beyond the 19 km target. The week shifted right with Monday entirely missed, but running output from Tuesday onward was outstanding. Gym work was severely under-delivered (1 of 3 planned sessions), and the 38% volume jump from W24 (32 km → 44.3 km) means W26 must be a consolidation week. HM Porto is now 12 weeks out.
highlights: First half-marathon training distance: 21.1 km at 6:01/km on Sunday — new long run peak, 25 segment PRs
5 run days vs 3 planned — exceptional aerobic consistency across Tue–Sun
'Que tosta' quality session Thursday with 9 segment PRs shows solid speed development
areas_to_improve: Only 1 of 3 planned gym sessions completed — strength work is lagging and must be reprioritised in W26
Monday was entirely missed — week started a day late; better early-week execution needed
Volume jumped 38% vs W24 — consolidate at 35-38 km in W26 before building further
